name: @ecadlabs/tezosx-mcp

tools.name: tezos_create_x402_payment
tools.description: Creates a signed Tezos payment for x402 protocol. Builds and signs a transfer operation without broadcasting it, then packages it as a base64-encoded X-PAYMENT header value.

amount.description: The amount in mutez to send

tools.name: tezos_fetch_with_x402
tools.description: Fetches a URL and automatically handles x402 payment requirements. If the server returns 402, it parses the requirements, creates a signed payment, and retries the request with the X-PAYMENT header. Use 'queryParams' to pass dynamic parameters to the endpoint (e.g., for NFT minting, pass {"recipient": "tz1..."} so the NFT goes to the user's wallet instead of the spender account).

maxAmountMutez.description: Maximum amount in mutez willing to pay (e.g., '500000' for 0.5 XTZ)

body.description: Request body for POST/PUT requests (JSON string)

queryParams.description: JSON object of query parameters to append to the URL (e.g., '{"recipient": "tz1...", "amount": "100"}')

tools.name: tezos_get_addresses
tools.description: Returns the spending contract address, owner address, and spender address from the contract storage.

tools.name: tezos_get_balance
tools.description: Returns the balance of the spending contract (usable tokens) and spending address (tokens for fees)

tools.name: tezos_get_limits
tools.description: Returns the spending limits and current usage from the contract: daily limit, per-transaction limit, amount spent today, and time until reset.

tools.name: tezos_get_operation_history
tools.description: Returns the last 100 transaction operations for the spending contract from TzKT API, ordered from most recent to oldest.

tools.name: tezos_parse_x402_requirements
tools.description: Parses a 402 response body containing x402 payment requirements for Tezos payments. Returns structured payment information including scheme, network, asset, amount, and recipient.

responseBody.description: The JSON response body from a 402 Payment Required response

tools.name: tezos_recover_spender_funds
tools.description: Transfers the spender address's XTZ balance (used for gas fees) to the contract owner or a specified address. Useful for recovering funds when decommissioning a spender or rebalancing. Always fetches the live on-chain balance — call this tool every time the user asks, even if a previous call returned zero.

destination.description: Address to send recovered funds to. Defaults to the contract owner's address.

tools.name: tezos_reveal_account
tools.description: Reveals the spender account's public key on the Tezos network. This is required before the account can perform any operations. The tool checks if the account is already revealed and only performs the reveal operation if needed.

tools.name: tezos_send_xtz
tools.description: Sends a set amount of Tez to another address via the spending contract.

toAddress.description: The address to send Tez to.

amount.description: The amount of Tez to send to the address.

tools.name: tezos_bridge_to_etherlink
tools.description: Bridges XTZ from Tezos to Etherlink via the native bridge. Sends XTZ from the spending contract through the Tezos-Etherlink bridge to the specified Etherlink address. The bridged XTZ will appear as native tokens on Etherlink after the rollup processes the deposit.

amount.description: The amount of XTZ to bridge to Etherlink.

etherlinkAddress.description: The Etherlink (0x) address to receive the bridged XTZ.

tools.name: tezos_bridge_status
tools.description: Checks the status of Tezos <-> Etherlink bridge transfers for a given address. Shows deposits (Tezos -> Etherlink), standard withdrawals (Etherlink -> Tezos), and fast withdrawals. Accepts either a Tezos or Etherlink address.

address.description: Tezos (tz1/tz2/KT1) or Etherlink (0x) address to check bridge transfers for. Defaults to the spending contract address.

tools.name: tezos_bridge_execute_withdrawal
tools.description: Executes a cemented outbox message on Tezos L1 to finalize a standard bridge withdrawal (Etherlink → Tezos). This can only be done after the commitment containing the withdrawal has been cemented (~15 days after initiation). Provide either outboxLevel + messageIndex (auto-fetches proof from rollup node) or cementedCommitment + outputProof directly. Requires ETHERLINK_ROLLUP_NODE_MAINNET or ETHERLINK_ROLLUP_NODE_SHADOWNET env var for auto-fetch mode.

outboxLevel.description: The Tezos L1 block level of the outbox containing the withdrawal message. Used with messageIndex to auto-fetch the proof from the rollup node.

messageIndex.description: The index of the message within the outbox level. Defaults to 0.

cementedCommitment.description: The cemented commitment hash (src1...). Required if outputProof is provided directly.

outputProof.description: The hex-encoded output proof. If provided along with cementedCommitment, skips rollup node query.

tools.name: tezos_get_dashboard
tools.description: Returns a link to the dashboard where the user can configure their contracts spending limits, spending keys, and deploy a new spending contract.
